items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: He’d been up all night, he worked the night with Stan Getz in I believe it was either Newport or Lake Placid.

ctx.x: He’d been up all night, he worked the night with Stan Getz in I believe it was either Newport or Lake Placid. I think he had the gig in Newport, which there’s recorded evidence with Stan Getz. I haven’t heard it — all you people out there, I’d like to hear it — and he either stayed up and drove to Geneva or there was another gig the night after that and then he stayed up all night and drove to Geneva. My dad saw him, blah, blah, blah, didn’t accompany him that night.
Well he was quite a pioneer of a sorts on the bass, and his work, did it affect your own playing?
